signatures.description: Implement a SysV AMD64 aggregate classification pass: given struct types mixing scalars, floats, fixed arrays and nested aggregates, compute each eightbyte's INTEGER/SSE/SSEUP/MEMORY class by applying the ABI merge rules (members split at eightbyte boundaries, unaligned fields demote the whole aggregate to MEMORY, aggregates larger than 16 bytes pass on the stack, MEMORY in one eightbyte forces MEMORY for all). Emit the exact parameter assignment (rdi/rsi/rdx/rcx/r8/r9, xmm0-xmm7) plus stack offsets, and validate against a cgo-built C harness that dumps the registers it actually received for at least 200 generated layouts, including 1-byte arrays that straddle eightbyte boundaries and mixed float/int tail fields.
